title: 20-Hydroxyecdysone inhibits inflammation via SIRT6-mediated NF-kappaB signaling in endothelial cells.
authors: Jin, Zhen; Wang, Bo; Ren, Lingxuan; Yang, Jianjun; Zheng, Zihan; Yao, Feng; Ding, Rongcheng; Wang, Jianjiang; He, Jianyu; Wang, Weirong; Nan, Guanjun; Lin, Rong
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Molecular cell research
one_liner_zh: 该文研究20-羟基蜕皮酮通过SIRT6介导NF-kappaB去乙酰化抑制内皮细胞炎症，虽涉及NF-kappaB与DNA结合相关信号通路，但核心是药物-蛋白互作与细胞实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: 20-Hydroxyecdysone (20E) is known to have numerous pharmacological activities and can be used to treat diabetes and cardiovascular diseases. However, the protective effects of 20E against endothelial dysfunction and its targets remain unclear. In the present study, we revealed that 20E treatment could modulate the release of the endothelium-derived vasomotor factors NO, PGI(2) and ET-1 and suppress the expression of ACE in TNF-alpha-induced 3D-cultured HUVECs. In addition, 20E suppressed the expression of CD40 and promoted the expression of SIRT6 in TNF-alpha-induced 3D-cultured HUVECs. The cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS) and molecular docking results demonstrated that 20E binding increased SIRT6 stability, indicating that 20E directly bound to SIRT6 in HUVECs. Further investigation of the underlying mechanism showed that 20E could upregulate SIRT6 levels and that SIRT6 knockdown abolished the regulatory effect of 20E on CD40 in TNF-alpha-induced HUVECs, while SIRT6 overexpression further improved the effect of 20E. Moreover, we found that 20E could reduce the acetylation of NF-kappaB p65 (K310) through SIRT6, but the catalytic inactive mutant SIRT6 (H133Y) did not promote the deacetylation of NF-kappaB p65, suggesting that the inhibitory effect of 20E on NF-kappaB p65 was dependent on SIRT6 deacetylase activity. Additionally, our results indicated that 20E inhibited NF-kappaB via SIRT6, and the expression of CD40 was increased in HUVECs treated with SIRT6 siRNA and NF-kappaB inhibitor. In conclusion, the present study demonstrates that 20E exerts its effect through SIRT6-mediated deacetylation of NF-kappaB p65 (K310) to inhibit CD40 expression in ECs, and 20E may have therapeutic potential for the treatment of cardiovascular diseases.
abstract_zh: 20-羟基蜕皮甾酮（20E）已知具有多种药理活性，可用于治疗糖尿病和心血管疾病。然而，20E对内皮功能障碍的保护作用及其靶点仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们揭示20E处理能够调节肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）诱导的三维培养人脐静脉内皮细胞（HUVECs）中内皮源性血管运动因子NO、PGI(2)和ET-1的释放，并抑制血管紧张素转换酶（ACE）的表达。此外，20E在TNF-alpha诱导的三维培养HUVECs中抑制了CD40的表达，并促进了SIRT6的表达。细胞热位移分析（CETSA）、药物亲和响应靶标稳定性（DARTS）和分子对接结果表明，20E结合增加了SIRT6的稳定性，表明20E直接结合HUVECs中的SIRT6。对潜在机制的进一步研究表明，20E能够上调SIRT6水平，而SIRT6敲低消除了20E对TNF-alpha诱导HUVECs中CD40的调节作用，而SIRT6过表达则进一步增强了20E的效果。此外，我们发现20E通过SIRT6减少NF-kappaB p65（K310）的乙酰化，但催化失活的SIRT6突变体（H133Y）并未促进NF-kappaB p65的去乙酰化，这表明20E对NF-kappaB p65的抑制作用依赖于SIRT6去乙酰化酶活性。另外，我们的结果表明20E通过SIRT6抑制NF-kappaB，并且在用SIRT6 siRNA和NF-kappaB抑制剂处理的HUVECs中，CD40的表达增加。总之，本研究证明20E通过SIRT6介导的NF-kappaB p65（K310）去乙酰化来抑制内皮细胞（ECs）中CD40的表达，并且20E可能具有治疗心血管疾病的潜力。
